title: Trace effective configuration values through layered config
prompt: This repository (package `orbit`) builds its runtime configuration from several layers (defaults, profiles, plugins, environment variables, constraints). Determine the effective values of the settings `http.timeout_seconds`, `cache.ttl_seconds` and `workers.max` when the service runs with profile `prod` and its process environment contains exactly the variables defined in deploy/prod.env (no other variables). The source code is the source of truth; documentation may be outdated. Write the answer to a file ANSWER.json in the repository root with exactly this shape (integers, no other keys): {"http.timeout_seconds": <int>, "cache.ttl_seconds": <int>, "workers.max": <int>}. Do not modify any existing files.
